extends SceneTree
# Tooling fixture only: inventory/GP seeded explicitly, not progression proof.
const Store = preload("res://scripts/save_store.gd")
func _initialize() -> void:
 var arguments := OS.get_cmdline_user_args()
 if arguments.size()!=1:
  quit(2)
  return
 var destination: String = arguments[0]
 var store = Store.new(destination.path_join("actual-schema3"))
 if not store.reset():
  printerr(store.warning)
  quit(1)
  return
 var payload: Dictionary = store.data.duplicate(true)
 payload.gp = 315
 payload.owned.append("mud")
 payload.build.tires = "mud"
 payload.build.paint = "cyan"
 payload.completed = ["meadow"]
 payload.stars = ["meadow:completion"]
 payload.claims = {"clear:meadow":true,"star:meadow:completion":true}
 payload.best = {"meadow":7.29166666666665}
 payload.explore.yaw = 0.0000001
 if not store.save_data(payload):
  printerr(store.warning)
  quit(1)
  return
 var cases: Array = []
 for number in [0.0,-0.0,0.65,0.0000001,-0.000000001,7.29166666666665,9.99999999999999,999999999.0,0.000000000000000000000000000001,0.0000000000000000000000000000000000000001,98765.4321098765]:
  var probe: Dictionary = store.data.duplicate(true)
  probe.numeric_probe = number
  cases.append({"payload":probe,"canonical":Store._canonical(probe)})
 var output := FileAccess.open(destination.path_join("canonical-cases.json"),FileAccess.WRITE)
 output.store_string(JSON.stringify(cases,"",true))
 output.close()
 print("ACTUAL_STORE_FIXTURE schema=",store.data.version," gp=",store.data.gp," tire=",store.data.build.tires," decimal_best=",store.data.best.meadow," tiny_yaw=",store.data.explore.yaw)
 quit()
